以下为基于任务目标的5条JSON训练数据（字段：instruction, context, response, difficulty）。内容聚焦于“使用AI代码助手生成单元测试并提供测试修复建议”的训练示例，供模型学习如何生成测试及修复建议的回答。为避免虚构真实世界证据，这些示例仅作为格式范例，具体实现可按你们的代码库与语言栈调整。

[
  {
    "instruction": "请使用AI代码助手为一个 Python 函数 factorial(n) 生成一组单元测试，并在测试失败时提供修复建议。测试应覆盖常见边界、正向用例以及错误输入处理，并给出每个测试的修复建议和解释。",
    "context": "{\"language\": \"Python\", \"framework\": \"PyTest\", \"target_function\": \"factorial(n)\", \"notes\": \"覆盖正向、边界、错误输入，提供修复建议\"}",
    "response": "{\"tests\": [ {\"name\": \"test_factorial_basic\", \"code\": \"def test_factorial_basic():\\n    from mymodule import factorial\\n    assert factorial(5) == 120\"}, {\"name\": \"test_factorial_zero\", \"code\": \"def test_factorial_zero():\\n    from mymodule import factorial\\n    assert factorial(0) == 1\"}, {\"name\": \"test_factorial_negative\", \"code\": \"def test_factorial_negative():\\n    import pytest\\n    from mymodule import factorial\\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError): factorial(-1)\"}, {\"name\": \"test_factorial_large\", \"code\": \"def test_factorial_large():\\n    from mymodule import factorial\\n    assert factorial(20) == 2432902008176640000\"} ], \"fix_suggestions\": [ {\"test\": \"test_factorial_negative\", \"suggestion\": \"Add input validation to raise ValueError for negative n before computation.\"}, {\"test\": \"test_factorial_zero\", \"suggestion\": \"Ensure factorial(0) returns 1 per mathematical convention.\"} ] }",
    "difficulty": "medium"
  },
  {
    "instruction": "使用 AI 代码助手为一个 JavaScript 函数 sumArray(arr) 生成一组 Jest 单元测试，并在测试失败时提供修复建议。覆盖空数组、正数、负数以及非数字输入场景。",
    "context": "{\"language\": \"JavaScript\", \"framework\": \"Jest\", \"target_function\": \"sumArray(arr)\", \"notes\": \"覆盖边界、数字类型校验\"}",
    "response": "{\"tests\": [ {\"name\": \"test_sumArray_basic\", \"code\": \"const { sumArray } = require('./mymodule');\\ntest('basic', () => { expect(sumArray([1,2,3,4])).toBe(10); });\"}, {\"name\": \"test_sumArray_empty\", \"code\": \"test('empty', () => { expect(sumArray([])).toBe(0); });\"}, {\"name\": \"test_sumArray_negative\", \"code\": \"test('negative', () => { expect(sumArray([-1,-2])).toBe(-3); });\"}, {\"name\": \"test_sumArray_non_numeric\", \"code\": \"test('non-numeric', () => { expect(() => sumArray([1, 'a'])).toThrow(); });\"} ], \"fix_suggestions\": [ {\"test\": \"test_sumArray_non_numeric\", \"suggestion\": \"Add input validation to reject non-numeric values or coerce them to numbers.\"} ] }",
    "difficulty": "easy"
  },
  {
    "instruction": "请用 AI 助手为一个 Java 方法 divide(a,b) 生成单元测试（JUnit），并在测试失败时提供修复建议，覆盖正常除法、除数为0、负数输入等情况。",
    "context": "{\"language\": \"Java\", \"framework\": \"JUnit\", \"target_function\": \"divide(a,b)\", \"notes\": \"包含异常处理场景\"}",
    "response": "{\"tests\": [ {\"name\": \"test_divide_basic\", \"code\": \"@Test public void test_divide_basic() { assertEquals(5, divide(10,2)); }\"}, {\"name\": \"test_divide_by_zero\", \"code\": \"@Test public void test_divide_by_zero() { assertThrows(ArithmeticException.class, () -> divide(1,0)); }\"}, {\"name\": \"test_divide_negative\", \"code\": \"@Test public void test_divide_negative() { assertEquals(-5, divide(-10,2)); }\"}, {\"name\": \"test_divide_zero_numerator\", \"code\": \"@Test public void test_divide_zero_numerator() { assertEquals(0, divide(0,5)); }\"} ], \"fix_suggestions\": [ {\"test\": \"test_divide_by_zero\", \"suggestion\": \"Document behavior for division by zero and consider returning a sentinel value or throwing ArithmeticException if not already implemented.\"} ] }",
    "difficulty": "hard"
  },
  {
    "instruction": "请使用 AI 助手为一个 Python 函数 parse_json(s) 生成单元测试（pytest），并在测试失败时提供修复建议，覆盖有效 JSON、无效 JSON、缺失字段和字段类型错误等场景。",
    "context": "{\"language\": \"Python\", \"framework\": \"pytest\", \"target_function\": \"parse_json(s)\", \"notes\": \"包含错误处理与输入验证\"}",
    "response": "{\"tests\": [ {\"name\": \"test_parse_json_valid\", \"code\": \"def test_parse_json_valid():\\n    from mymodule import parse_json\\n    s = '{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Alice\\\", \\\"age\\\": 30}'\\n    assert parse_json(s) == {\\\"name\\\": \\\"Alice\\\", \\\"age\\\": 30}\\n'\"}, {\"name\": \"test_parse_json_invalid\", \"code\": \"def test_parse_json_invalid():\\n    from mymodule import parse_json\\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError): parse_json('{invalid json}')\"}, {\"name\": \"test_parse_json_missing_field\", \"code\": \"def test_parse_json_missing_field():\\n    from mymodule import parse_json\\n    with pytest.raises(KeyError): parse_json('{\\\"name\\\": \\\"Bob\\\"}')\"}, {\"name\": \"test_parse_json_wrong_type\", \"code\": \"def test_parse_json_wrong_type():\\n    from mymodule import parse_json\\n    with pytest.raises(TypeError): parse_json('{\\\"age\\\": \\\"old\\\"}')\"} ], \"fix_suggestions\": [ {\"test\": \"test_parse_json_invalid\", \"suggestion\": \"Improve input validation to raise ValueError on malformed JSON before parsing.\"}, {\"test\": \"test_parse_json_missing_field\", \"suggestion\": \"Validate required keys exist and provide clear error when missing.\"} ] }",
    "difficulty": "hard"
  },
  {
    "instruction": "请用 Go 语言编写 AI 助手生成的单元测试，针对一个简单的序列化函数 serializeUser(user) 返回 JSON 字符串。测试应覆盖基本用例、空对象以及字段排序的一致性。",
    "context": "{\"language\": \"Go\", \"framework\": \"testing\", \"target_function\": \"SerializeUser(user)\", \"notes\": \"返回稳定的 JSON 字符串，字段顺序一致\"}",
    "response": "{\"tests\": [ {\"name\": \"TestSerializeUserBasic\", \"code\": \"func TestSerializeUserBasic(t *testing.T) { u := User{ID:1, Name:\\\"Alice\\\"}; got, err := SerializeUser(u); if err != nil { t.Fatalf(\\\"unexpected error: %v\\\", err) }; want := \\\"{\\\"id\\\":1,\\\"name\\\":\\\"Alice\\\"}\\\"; if got != want { t.Fatalf(\\\"expected %s but got %s\\\", want, got) } }\"}, {\"name\": \"TestSerializeUserZero\", \"code\": \"func TestSerializeUserZero(t *testing.T) { var u User; got, _ := SerializeUser(u); if got == \\\"{\\\"id\\\":0,\\\"name\\\":\\\"\\\"}\\\" { t.Errorf(\\\"unexpected default serialization\\\") } }\"} ], \"fix_suggestions\": [ {\"test\": \"TestSerializeUserBasic\", \"suggestion\": \"Ensure SerializeUser uses json.Marshal with deterministic field order and proper tags.\"} ] }",
    "difficulty": "medium"
  }
]
